config.label: Your practice's portal, scheme and host only, e
config.description: Your practice's portal, scheme and host only, e.g. https://<practice>intouch.insynchcs.com.

config.label: Portal username
config.description: Portal username. Set with INSYNC_PASSWORD to sign in server-side. Leave both empty to relay through your signed-in browser tab.

config.label: Portal password
config.description: Portal password. A rejected sign-in is never retried automatically, because the portal counts failures toward a lockout.

config.label: server or fetchproxy
config.description: server or fetchproxy. Default: server when both credentials are set, otherwise fetchproxy.

config.label: Where downloaded files are written locally (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands)
config.description: Where downloaded files are written locally (a path-delimiter list; ~ expands). Default ~/Downloads and ~/Documents. A per-call dest must resolve inside one of these.

config.label: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk — for a hosted runner whose disk the user cannot reach
config.description: true returns downloaded bytes inline (base64) instead of writing to disk — for a hosted runner whose disk the user cannot reach. Default false (disk).

config.label: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127
config.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

config.label: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/
config.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
